clock.states: Exact FZP frame at t; t=0 explicitly empty initialization.
clock.flows: (window_start_s,window_end_s]; each transition bracket is (t-5,t]. No exact within-interval event time claimed.
clock.forecast_use: Future observed boundaries are diagnostic replay only. Genuine forecasts must use records ending at/before their initialization cutoff.
clock.end: Last-frame vehicles remain stock; no tail extrapolation or terminal disappearance invented.

definitions.speed: vehicle arithmetic mean; null empty; score only n>=5
definitions.mainline_crossing: Forward canonical position crosses spatial edge, including within same physical link and multi-cell movement.
definitions.off_departure: Mainline vehicle observed next on named off-ramp connector; separate from downstream mainline crossings. Unique endpoint-to-endpoint connector skips also counted and flagged.
definitions.ramp_merge: Named ramp connector vehicle observed next on mainline; queued connector stock measured separately. Unique endpoint-to-endpoint connector skips also counted and flagged.
definitions.source_admission: First-appearance insertion on source chain, or source negative-to-nonnegative coordinate crossing; excludes seen-ID reappearance.
definitions.birth: First-ever observation on mainline; evidence, not an additional additive inflow.
definitions.terminal_exit: 5-second kinematic inference at final physical chain end after excluding native removal; not directly observed beyond-network passage or certified Omega TTD.
definitions.excluded: Unverified entries/losses retained in conservation; only unique physical connector skips inferred, without a claimed lane or exact crossing time.
